facts.fact: EUAA reports banks use NIRA electronic verification for account opening and transactions, over 23,000 verifications by March 2026.
EUAA reports verification against the NIRA ID in banking, business registration, education and transport business as of March 2026.
EUAA reports over 23,000 electronic verifications using the ID by March 2026, and more than 24 public and private services integrated by November 2025.
